INSERT INTO subway_notice ( notice_title, notice_content, notice_type_code, notice_time, line_name_list, station_section_code_list, reference_date, abnormal_start_time, abnormal_end_time, nonstop_yn )
VALUES ( #{noticeTitle}, #{noticeContent}, #{noticeTypeCode}, #{noticeTime}, #{lineNameList}, #{stationSectionCodeList}, #{referenceDate}, #{abnormalStartTime}, #{abnormalEndTime}, #{nonstopYn} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
NOTICE_ID AS noticeId,
NOTICE_TITLE AS noticeTitle,
NOTICE_CONTENT AS noticeContent,
NOTICE_TYPE_CODE AS noticeTypeCode,
NOTICE_TIME AS noticeTime,
LINE_NAME_LIST AS lineNameList,
STATION_SECTION_CODE_LIST AS stationSectionCodeList,
REFERENCE_DATE AS referenceDate,
ABNORMAL_START_TIME AS abnormalStartTime,
ABNORMAL_END_TIME AS abnormalEndTime,
NONSTOP_YN AS nonstopYn
FROM SUBWAY_NOTICE
WHERE REPLACE(REFERENCE_DATE, '-', '') = DATE_FORMAT(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y%m%d')
ORDER BY NOTICE_TIME
